thread:
Asha (Sec): Alert: a widely-used CI plugin (thirdparty/fast-cache) has a critical RCE vuln (CVE-2026-XXXX). We detected it in our build logs via the supply-chain scanner. Immediate action required: remove plugin from pipelines or upgrade to patched v2.1.4. More details in SEC-5277.
Devon (CI): Which pipelines are affected? I can grep config across org.
sec-bot: Initial scan found 42 pipelines referencing fast-cache v2.0.x in infra repos and 9 in product teams. Full inventory posted to SEC-5277.
Maya (SRE): Risk: the plugin runs with repo checkout permissions and can exfiltrate secrets if exploited. We should assume compromise until validated.
Raj (DevTools): Quick mitigation: a) disable plugin execution via CI feature flag, b) replace with internal cache step (s3-backed) or c) upgrade to 2.1.4 which removes vulnerable code path.
Devon (CI): I'll push a temporary org-wide CI flag to disable thirdparty plugin execution and open PR templates for replacement. ETA 30m.
Asha (Sec): Good. Owners: 1) search your repos for fast-cache usage, 2) either upgrade to 2.1.4 or remove the step and use the internal cache pattern, 3) rotate any creds that might have run during the window (logs show last run 2026-03-10 03:12Z). Paste remediation proof into SEC-5277.
Maya (SRE): For pipelines that uploaded artifacts during the vulnerable window, create a provenance ticket and re-run builds after hardening. I'll coordinate rebuilds for infra images.
Devon (CI): I'm bumping the pipeline registry and adding a lint rule to block pinning fast-cache <2.1.4. Also scanning historical builds for suspicious post-checkout network calls.
sec-bot: Automated tasks: 1) org-wide search for plugin usage (done), 2) scheduled secret-scan for build logs, 3) notify owners listed in SEC-5277. Results will update this thread.
Asha (Sec): If you need emergency rollback or help with rotation, tag me or sec-oncall. We'll enforce plugin bans after 48h if teams don't remediate. Priority: infra and prod pipelines first. :rotating_light: :lock:
